nodes.label: auth0-setup.md
nodes.rationale: No client secret anywhere: web and Windows apps use authorization code flow with PKCE, server only verifies tokens against public keys. RBAC off so access is decided by backend relationships.

nodes.label: Session renewal
nodes.rationale: auth0_flutter has no token renewal on Windows, so the app exchanges the stored refresh token itself.

nodes.label: contest-options.md
nodes.rationale: Storing the full resolved settings in each configuration revision means a revision never changes meaning even if a later app version changes a platform default.

nodes.label: contest-state-and-transitions.md
nodes.rationale: Separating lifecycle from scoring access, admin lock, results hiding, publication and archive prevents one control being mistaken for an execution state change.

nodes.label: embedded-api-security.md
nodes.rationale: Protects the loopback embedded server against other local processes and cross-site web pages via Host, Origin, bearer secret and content-type checks.
